example_prompt: Build a USSD menu (*123#) with Africa's Talking: answer each step of the session with CON or END.

input_schema.description: Form fields (application/x-www-form-urlencoded) Africa's Talking POSTs to your callback URL "when the user dials a USSD code and every time they respond to a menu".

sessionId.description: A unique value generated when the session starts and sent every time a mobile subscriber response has been received.

phoneNumber.description: The number of the mobile subscriber interacting with your ussd application.

networkCode.description: The telco of the phoneNumber interacting with your ussd application (the end-of-session notification page lists the codes; 99999 = Athena, the sandbox).

serviceCode.description: The USSD code assigned to your application.

text.description: The user input: an empty string in the first request of a session, then all the user input of the session concatenated with * (e.g. "1*1" after choosing 1 twice).

response_schema.description: Plain text (Content-Type: text/plain) shown to the user. Begin it with CON if the session goes on (the user can answer), with END if it is the last response of the session — in the docs' samples a space follows the word (e.g. CON What would you want to check, then 1. My Account on the next line). Optional response header at-ussd-hop-metadata: text naming the step (e.g. WelcomeMenuPage), at most 99 characters, no pipe |; it comes back in the next request under the same header name and is shown in the dashboard's session details.

error_schema.description: "If we get a HTTP error response (Code 40X) from your script, or a malformed response (does not begin with CON or END), we will terminate the USSD session gracefully."

gotchas: Prerequisites: "Register a service code with us" and "Register a callback URL that we will call whenever we get a request from a user coming into our system."
Answer within 10 seconds: "the expected response time from your application is at most 10 seconds."

Route on text, not on a counter: it is "" on the first request, then every answer of the session joined with * ("1", then "1*2"…). Split on * to get the path through your menu; sessionId identifies the session across requests.
Every response must begin with CON or END. Anything else, or an HTTP 40X, terminates the session.
"Your USSD Menu should not contain special characters as the telcos are unable to render such content".
at-ussd-hop-metadata is shown in the dashboard: "take note not to share sensitive details in this header". At most 99 characters, no |.
To learn how a session ended (user hung up, error, success), add the end-of-session callback: webhook_ussd_end_of_session.
open_questions: The docs describe no way to authenticate these requests (no signature, secret or source IP list): anyone who knows the callback URL can POST to it.
What happens after 10 seconds, on an HTTP 5xx or on a timeout: the docs only name "a HTTP error response (Code 40X)" and a malformed response as terminating the session.
